## Sleep and wake
- **Your Mac can sleep while you're away:** Hosting Connect no longer keeps the Mac awake on its own. Controller still keeps it awake while agents are working, and for a few minutes while a connected device is using it. - **Sleeping, not offline:** Before your Mac sleeps, it tells your connected iPhone and other Macs, which show **Mac is sleeping** instead of trying to reconnect. Chats you've already opened stay readable while it sleeps. - **Wake Mac:** Choose **Wake** on a sleeping Mac to wake it over your local network. With **Wake Mac automatically when needed** on, sending a message, answering an approval or starting a chat wakes it for you. - **Choose who can wake this Mac:** Connect settings has an **Allow remote wake** option, which you can limit to times the Mac is on power. It also tells you if **Wake for network access** is off in System Settings → Battery, since remote wake needs it.
## Agents
- **OpenCode retries provider failures:** When the model provider fails partway through a turn, OpenCode now retries and picks up where it left off. Errors that end a turn and retry notices now stay visible in the conversation even with background notices hidden. - **Steering Antigravity and Droid:** Sending a new message while Antigravity or Factory Droid is working now redirects it reliably, including when you send several in a row. Tools stopped by steering show as interrupted or cancelled instead of failed.
## Faster conversations
- Scrolling while an agent works is smoother, especially during long runs of tool calls and messages between them. - Expanded reasoning shows the agent's full trace paragraphs, fades in as one continuous sweep, and no longer jumps or overlaps text when you open it.
## Fixed
- Opening the browser panel could crash Controller 1.0.33. This release fixes it.

## Fixed
- Controller 1.0.32 quit as soon as it opened. This release fixes it. If you installed 1.0.32, download this version from Controller's GitHub releases page: Controller can't update itself while it can't open. - The crash reporter couldn't start under Enhanced Security's platform restrictions, so Controller now runs without that one restriction. Its other Enhanced Security protections stay on.
## Crash reporting
- Controller now reports crashes and app hangs to Sentry, so they can be fixed without waiting for a report. On the Mac, it also reports harness messages that Controller couldn't read, so harness updates get supported sooner. - Reports never include your name, account, IP address, screenshots, conversations, files or network requests.
## Antigravity
- Antigravity uses Google's ACP server 1.3.0, which adds its third-party models such as Claude and GPT-OSS, with their reasoning levels in the model picker.
## Cursor
- Options you haven't changed now use Cursor's current setting instead of being left out of the request. For example, Grok 4.7 now runs with the 500K context the picker shows instead of falling back to 256K.

## Claude runs on the Claude Agent SDK
- Claude conversations now run through Controller's built-in Swift port of the Claude Agent SDK instead of `claude -p`. Sessions, approvals, questions, plans and Controller's tools work as before. - Changing the model, effort or access mode and then stopping the turn while Claude applies it no longer leaves the session on the wrong setting; the next turn restores it.
## Cursor
- Cursor runs through its official SDK: steer a turn between steps, follow its subagents live, and see a live context meter, imports and usage history from Cursor's local store.
## Conversations
- Subagents appear as live rows with their conversations inline, on Mac and iPhone. Pi and Grok subagent spawns show in the transcript. - The transcript stays attached at the bottom while following, honors every jump, and stays still under a send. - The plan chip updates in place, now on iPhone and iPad too. - Reduce Motion applies the same way everywhere.
## iPhone and iPad
- Every Mac you follow combines into one Live Activity. - Crop images and use an expanded markup toolbar before sending.
## Usage
- Usage combines every Mac's plan limits and keeps each harness's limits current.
Controller now includes the Sentry SDK and uploads debug symbols for crash diagnostics; crash reporting is not turned on yet.
